title: Rogue: Updatable Matrix Lookup Arguments and Applications to Verifiable Databases
venue: ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security
abstract: Lookup arguments let a prover show that queried values belong to committed data. Rogue studies matrix lookups when the underlying table changes, combining update support with efficient batch queries. The work connects cryptographic lookup arguments with verifiable databases and index structures. I implemented algorithms and evaluated their performance as part of this collaborative work.
summary: Develops updatable matrix lookup arguments so that verifiable database queries can use efficiently maintained data structures.
